note: Documentation fixtures for issue #65's scheduler invocation contract. These are hand-authored worked examples with occurrence_id values precomputed from the canonical serialization rule defined in the contract doc. tests/test_scheduler_invocation_contract_fixture.py recomputes and validates occurrence_id independently; it does not implement or invoke any scheduler adapter.

valid_cases.name: morning_openclaw
valid_cases.description: Current OpenClaw scheduler adapter mapping for MorningWorkflow.

valid_cases.name: daily_analytics_openclaw
valid_cases.description: Current OpenClaw scheduler adapter mapping for AnalyticsWorkflow.

valid_cases.name: story_openclaw
valid_cases.description: Current OpenClaw scheduler adapter mapping for StoryWorkflow.

valid_cases.name: breaking_openclaw
valid_cases.description: Current OpenClaw scheduler adapter mapping for BreakingWorkflow.

valid_cases.name: morning_systemd_alternate
valid_cases.description: Hypothetical alternate scheduler (systemd timer) mapping the same MorningWorkflow occurrence shape into an identical contract, proving the contract does not depend on OpenClaw. Not an implemented adapter.

replay_examples.name: morning_openclaw_retry_same_occurrence
replay_examples.description: Same logical scheduler occurrence retried/re-observed later: identical workflow_id, source, external_occurrence_id, and scheduled_for as morning_openclaw, but a different triggered_at. Must yield the SAME occurrence_id as morning_openclaw.

distinct_occurrence_examples.name: distinct_workflow_id
distinct_occurrence_examples.description: Baseline morning_openclaw with only workflow_id changed. Must produce a DIFFERENT occurrence_id than morning_openclaw.

distinct_occurrence_examples.name: distinct_source
distinct_occurrence_examples.description: Baseline morning_openclaw with only source changed. Must produce a DIFFERENT occurrence_id than morning_openclaw.

distinct_occurrence_examples.name: distinct_external_occurrence_id
distinct_occurrence_examples.description: Baseline morning_openclaw with only external_occurrence_id changed. Must produce a DIFFERENT occurrence_id than morning_openclaw.

distinct_occurrence_examples.name: distinct_scheduled_for
distinct_occurrence_examples.description: Baseline morning_openclaw with only scheduled_for changed. Must produce a DIFFERENT occurrence_id than morning_openclaw.

invalid_cases.name: missing_external_occurrence_id
invalid_cases.description: external_occurrence_id must never be backfilled with current time; a missing value is invalid input, not an empty-but-valid occurrence.

invalid_cases.name: empty_external_occurrence_id
invalid_cases.description: An empty/whitespace-only external_occurrence_id is invalid; it must never be treated as an opaque valid identity.

invalid_cases.name: unknown_workflow_id
invalid_cases.description: workflow_id must be one of the four current accepted values; an adapter's own job name is never substituted.

invalid_cases.name: non_canonical_scheduled_for_offset
invalid_cases.description: scheduled_for must be canonical UTC RFC 3339 (Z suffix); a numeric UTC offset is rejected even though it denotes the same instant.

invalid_cases.name: non_canonical_triggered_at_fraction
invalid_cases.description: triggered_at must be canonical UTC RFC 3339 with no fractional seconds.

invalid_cases.name: malformed_occurrence_id_shape
invalid_cases.description: occurrence_id must match occ_ followed by exactly 24 lowercase hex characters; this value is the wrong length.

invalid_cases.name: occurrence_id_mismatch
invalid_cases.description: occurrence_id does not match the recomputed value for the stable fields; this is invalid input, not a new occurrence.

invalid_cases.name: unknown_extra_field
invalid_cases.description: An unrecognized additional field is rejected; the field set is exact, not extensible.
